start: Settings, Backup and restore, card 'Keep your workouts on MettleUp', not signed in, a build with a real Google client id

user_sees: 'Sign in with Google to keep your workouts safe. MettleUp then saves your workouts, routines and body weight to your account by itself...'
'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'
The 18+ and terms tick box (first time)
must_not: The card shown in a build without a Google client id

steps.action: Tick the box, tap 'Continue with Google', pick an account
user_sees: 'Your workouts will be saved on MettleUp in a moment.' then 'Your workouts are saved to your MettleUp account automatically. Last saved: ...'
must_not: Workouts sent before the server copy was brought back

start: Welcome screen of a new phone, member used MettleUp before

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' under 'Used MettleUp before? Sign in to bring your workouts back.'
user_sees: The app opens with the member's profile and 'N workouts brought back to this phone.'
Or 'You are signed in. Nothing is saved yet, so answer the 3 questions to start.'
must_not: The welcome questions asked again when a profile was kept

user_sees: Question 'Sign out of MettleUp?' - 'Your workouts stay on this phone. New workouts are not saved on MettleUp until you sign in again.'
The card shows 'Continue with Google' again; workouts still on the phone
must_not: Google signed out while the Drive backup still uses that account

start: Card 'Keep your workouts on MettleUp', various refusals

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' without ticking the box
user_sees: The box's error line; Google's sheet does not open
must_not: Signed in without the 18+ and terms agreement
An error for a simple cancel

steps.action: Sign in with a different Google account than the one whose workouts are on this phone
user_sees: 'This phone has another person's workouts. To use a different Google account, first erase this phone in Settings -> "Erase or start over".'
must_not: The other person's workouts sent to or merged into this account

steps.action: On an iPhone, or with no internet
user_sees: 'Google sign-in is not on iPhone yet. It comes in a later update.' / 'Could not sign in with Google. Check your internet and try again.'

start: Signed in earlier, then signed out

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' with the same account
user_sees: 'Signed in as ...'; the newest edits win; nothing doubled
must_not: Workouts doubled after signing in again

user_sees: 'Sign in again to keep saving your workouts on MettleUp.' and a 'Continue with Google' button on the card
must_not: Saving silently stopped with 'Last saved' still shown as fine

user_sees: 'Your space on MettleUp is full, so new workouts stay on this phone only. Please tell us in Settings -> "Help and feedback".'
must_not: Workouts lost because the server refused them

start: Signed in member at a gym

steps.action: Log a workout; ask who can see it
user_sees: 'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'
must_not: The gym panel showing the saved copy
Progress photos sent to the server
